mirror-1 NISSEDAL 25 5/8x59" (top, moved from the extras onto the plan): hung vertically on the walkway stretch of the 70" wall, rot 180, x 103.8-129.4, flat to the wall, so the 36" walkway stays clear: the full-length mirror between the closet and the bathroom.
Walkways (F-30): door to bathroom along the bottom of the room, open floor past the column and 36" beside the bed; the 36" landings in front of the closet and the bathroom door stay clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door).
Window wall: nothing but the curtains and a corner lamp. F-33 allows furniture 6" off the heater, but a cabinet there would box in the heater along the whole hatched wall (heater-depth-assumed), so no BESTÅ goes on it.
Extras: VALEVÅG mattress x1, DVALA queen sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE Full/Queen insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA natural cover set x1, VILDKORN pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window).
Not placed: the MALM King ikea-09574348, the bed Andrew linked (82 1/4" wide: under 24" on each side, F-34); the PERJOHAN bench ikea-60485339 (pine against the dark veneer; e keeps it with the TARVA); the BRIMNES 3-door wardrobe ikea-90574800 (no wall takes 46" plus 24" in front); the 50 3/4" BESTÅ ikea-69429706 (rejected: the 76" one stores more on the same footprint); the STORKLINTA and HEMNES 2-drawer nightstands ikea-90559296 and ikea-80242627 (18 7/8" and 15" deep, they stood in front of the bathroom doorway; design review 2026-10-23) and a second VIHALS nightstand (any floor nightstand on the bathroom side stands in the bathroom door's 36" landing, F-31); the black BRIMNES bed ikea-79129608 (its white twin is in f).
Why every variant keeps the headboard on the right wall: the top wall is the heater wall (F-33); on the left wall a queen plus two nightstands needs 102" and only 91" is free between the heater clearance (y 12) and the door's swing (y 103); on the 70" bottom wall the nightstands would stand in the closet's and the bathroom door's 36" landings.
Total $1,938.79: placed $1,279.89 + extras $658.90; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed, anchor-required (dresser-1, storage-1).
Re-staged 2026-10-23 (F-64): the MALM in place of the TARVA. How the bathroom side came to a floating shelf is in e's notes.
2026-10-25: the heater is 3" deep (Andrew), not the 6" drawn when this layout was made, so every clearance to its face above is 3" more and heater-depth-assumed no longer applies; the bathroom door's landing is now 30" (Andrew: "ok"), and this layout keeps 36" clear in front of it. The NISSEDAL mirror is glass with no safety film on its page (F-21: no glass): a and h leave it out; here, hang one with a safety film, or leave it out.
